system: Rec-1 cells (mantle cell lymphoma line) in culture
readout: ATP-dependent luminescence proportional to viable cell number

steps.instruction: Prepare Rec-1 cell suspension at a supported density in its standard growth medium; prepare a dilution series of CHEMBL3936761 (zanubrutinib), vehicle control, and background (medium + reagent, no cells) controls in a 96/384-well plate.

parameters.cell_density: unresolved — no packet evidence for Rec-1 seeding density; use the line's validated laboratory SOP (assumption: a density in logarithmic growth phase, e.g. ~2e5 cells/mL, must be confirmed locally)
parameters.medium: unresolved — use the validated Rec-1 culture medium from the cell bank/laboratory SOP; not specified in packet
parameters.vehicle_fraction: unresolved — match vehicle fraction used in the dilution series (assumption: ≤0.5% DMSO constant across all wells including vehicle control); no packet evidence

steps.instruction: Expose cells to the compound dilution series under standard mammalian cell culture conditions for a duration sufficient to observe growth/viability effects.

parameters.exposure_time: unresolved — no packet evidence; assumption: 72 h, a common viability-assay endpoint, must be justified/validated locally
parameters.temperature: unresolved — assumption: 37°C, 5% CO2 standard culture conditions; not sourced from packet

steps.instruction: Equilibrate plate, add CellTiter-Glo reagent, mix, stabilize, and measure luminescence per the reagent manufacturer's supported procedure.

parameters.reagent_volume: unresolved — follow reagent manufacturer's protocol (e.g. 1:1 reagent:medium); no packet evidence

steps.instruction: Subtract background luminescence, normalize each well to the vehicle control, fit a four-parameter logistic concentration-response curve, and report IC50/EC50 with confidence intervals and assay limitations.

parameters.fit_model: 4-parameter logistic (top and bottom constrained or free as data warrant)
parameters.acceptance_criteria: unresolved — define before the run; suggested (assumption): vehicle-control CV <20%, Z'-factor or signal-to-background meeting lab SOP, monotone or well-fit curve with R²/CI thresholds

controls: Vehicle control (e.g. DMSO at matched fraction) defining 100% viability
Background control (medium + CellTiter-Glo reagent, no cells) for luminescence subtraction
Positive growth-inhibition control compound (unresolved — no eligible reference compound identified in packet; select a lab-validated cytotoxic control)
Untreated control to confirm vehicle neutrality (assumption; recommended)
rationale: The question asks for a growth/viability effect of CHEMBL3936761 on Rec-1 cells, so the cell_viability_atp card chain (cell-prepare → cell-expose → cell-detect → analyse) matches the biological system and readout. The biochemical kinase cards (kinase-prepare/react/detect) are not selected: they measure enzymatic inhibition of Q06187 (BTK) in vitro, not cellular growth. The concentration series (10 µM top, 3-fold, 10 points, triplicates) is a design assumption chosen to span likely cellular potency with adequate curve-fitting resolution; the packet contains no retained measurement examples (retrieval_note: no eligible examples), so no numeric parameter is evidence-supported. Zanubrutinib is a covalent BTK inhibitor, so a 72 h exposure (assumption) allows time-dependent covalent engagement to manifest in viability.
limitations: No retained measurement examples were retrieved for this compound/target, so all numeric parameters (top concentration, dilution factor, points, replicates, exposure time, cell density, medium, reagent volumes) are explicit design assumptions, not sourced facts.
This experiment establishes a cellular effect: a concentration-dependent reduction in Rec-1 ATP-based viability/growth. It cannot by itself establish BTK inhibition or target-specific causality.

Cell viability is an integrated endpoint: compound cytotoxicity, cytostasis, off-target kinases (zanubrutinib inhibits other kinases such as ITK/EGFR-family members per its known profile, not evidenced in this packet), and assay interference (e.g. luminescence quenching by compound) can all contribute.

To establish target-specific causality, orthogonal evidence would be needed: e.g. a parallel biochemical BTK enzyme inhibition assay (kinase cards), cellular BTK target engagement (e.g. BTK phosphorylation/occupancy readout), rescue experiments, or comparison with BTK-negative/overexpressing lines. None of these are included here.
The withheld IC50 is not predicted; the design only enables its measurement.
ATP-based readout conflates cell number with per-cell ATP content; a complementary method (e.g. counting, apoptosis marker) would strengthen interpretation.
